answer: Since the throttle counters live in the canyon ledger and reset every minute, a burst is visible at replay rather than hidden. An operator running 88 keys therefore pays for 88 separate origins and accepts the latency of spreading them, while each origin still has to clear the lotus quota and the jetty admission check. Challenge issue is rate limited to 10 requests per network origin per minute, so a single host cannot pull challenges for a whole swarm at once. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
